text_block_list.text:
One morning on a day off, I spotted Daiwa 
Scarlet in front of a pharmacy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geh. Trainer!? Stop! Don't come any 
closer!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? Well... I-I got a 
pimple... on my forehead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I deliberately left early this morning 
specifically to avoid running into anyone 
I know. Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, that's the deal! See ya!

Daiwa Scarlet seemed troubled by skin 
problems...
